name: Conformance: Credential
description: RFC 0199 §C. One conformance.oauth.use node declaring auth { type: oauth2, provider: synthetic, scopes: [openwop.read] }. Run by a Subject with no credential for synthetic: under oauth.credentialInterrupt the node suspends on a credential interrupt (waiting-input); without the facet the host fails the node (RFC 0047 §C.3). Opt-in: a host advertises it only when it advertises oauth with the synthetic provider. See conformance/fixtures.md and v2-credential-interrupt.test.ts.
